categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of electrical wires and cables, aluminum doors and windows, curtain walls, and related construction engineering services. It also engages in international trade and real estate development and leasing. Key product lines include overhead aluminum conductors, cross-linked polyethylene insulated power cables, high-performance aluminum doors and windows, and curtain wall systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include advanced aluminum and copper wire rolling, drawing, and extrusion processes, cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) insulation for power cables, and development of ultra-heat-resistant aluminum conductors (ZTACIR). The company employs specialized manufacturing for high-voltage cables up to 345KV, carbon fiber aluminum conductors, and integrates industrial 4.0 concepts and ERP systems for production automation. It also collaborates with Japanese firms for OEM aluminum door/window products and uses advanced testing equipment like 2400KV impulse test devices.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are Taiwan Power Company (Taipower) and contractors serving Taipower for electrical cables, and domestic construction companies and real estate developers for aluminum doors, windows, and curtain walls. The company serves mainly the domestic Taiwanese market with 100% domestic sales, focusing on infrastructure, industrial, residential, and commercial building sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales are concentrated in Taiwan, with no significant export sales reported. The company has multiple factories and offices across Taiwan including Taipei, New Taipei, Taoyuan, Taichung, and Kaohsiung. It collaborates with Japanese partners for product development but sales remain domestic.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream manufacturing segment, producing raw and processed aluminum and copper wires, cables, and aluminum building components. It also extends downstream by providing installation and engineering services for electrical and construction projects, including turnkey cable installation and curtain wall construction.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic R&D focuses on developing high-value, high-performance products such as ultra-heat-resistant aluminum conductors (ZTACIR), 345KV XLPE cables, low-loss carbon fiber aluminum conductors, and high water-tightness aluminum doors and windows. The company emphasizes energy efficiency, carbon reduction, and compliance with future carbon neutrality goals. It also invests in solar power and energy storage systems to support sustainable operations and plans to enhance industrial automation and ERP integration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of electrical wires, cables, aluminum doors/windows, and curtain walls. The company also earns from engineering and installation services related to these products. There is no indication of subscription or licensing models; revenue is primarily transactional and project-based.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in Taiwan’s electrical wire and cable industry and aluminum building materials market. It faces competition from domestic firms like Taipower’s other suppliers and international competitors such as Korean LS Cable, especially in ultra-heat-resistant conductor segments. The company maintains competitive advantages through product innovation, strategic partnerships (e.g., with Japanese TOSTEM), and participation in major Taipower infrastructure projects.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported annual revenues of approximately NT$4.54 billion in the latest fiscal year, showing a 13.11% increase from the prior year. Net profit after tax was about NT$452.7 million, slightly down by 4.61%. The company has a stable asset base of over NT$10.8 billion and equity of NT$7.13 billion, with a moderate debt ratio around 34%. It demonstrates steady growth with ongoing capital investments and R&D expenditures around NT$11 million annually.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, reliable, and technologically advanced products tailored to Taiwan’s power infrastructure and construction needs. Its value proposition includes superior product performance such as ultra-heat-resistant conductors, energy-efficient and high water-tightness aluminum doors/windows, and integrated engineering services. Collaborations with international partners and commitment to sustainability and carbon reduction further differentiate its offerings.
